notes.title: Update 1.12 (World Oceans Day Sale!)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today we're bringing a small update to Deep Diving Simulator and we would like to let you know that we are going to run a pretty substantial discount as today is World Oceans Day!

Expect the discount to be available in the upcoming hours and please note that our oceans and seas do need our attention. Let's help them out!

As for the game, let's present what is new:

Patch Notes 1.12

fixed some localization issues
fixed some collectibles positions (as in clipping)
fixed some interaction bugs
fixed some audio issues
fixed subtitles disappearing in the menu when inactive


A small update, but an update you all deserve! Thank you for your continuous support! Let us know how the game is doing now with our improvements!

Until next time!

notes.title: Update 1.11 and Upcoming Sale!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's been a long time and right of the bat we would like to thank you for your continuous support, we hope that you are enjoying your time in Deep Diving Simulator during these tough times. Today we would like to introduce you to a small patch which fixes some minor bugs, and we encourage you to take part in the upcoming World Oceans Day which begins June 8th 2020.

Update 1.11

fixed minor bugs


Right! Starting June 8th our Deep Diving Simulator and Deep Diving VR will both be available with an incredible -80% OFF discount! Now that's a good deal!

Unfortunately, that's all we've got for you today. Happy diving!

Until next time guys and stay safe out there!

notes.title: Adventure Pack Patch 1.20
notes.notes:
HELLO EVERYONE!

We've been able to fix two small issues that have been bothering our players. Take a look:

CHANGELOG
- fixed the mining cart interaction not responding to the Eco-Gun's single-charge beam in Dead Mines. Now the player should be able to destroy the item with ease.
- fixed one seashell in Silent Cove that didn't want to be picked up. Now the player should be able to pick it up.

That's about it for this little patch. If you notice anything strange, please let us know in the Steam discussions by creating a thread with a description of your problem or you can shoot us an e-mail to support@jujubee.pl where we will try to help you out.

Thank you for your assistance guys, you are awesome! :)

Until next time!

notes.title: Adventure Pack Patch 1.17
notes.notes:
HELLO EVERYONE!

We are nearly 24 hours from launching our Adventure Pack and we are bringing you a patch 1.17 that should fix a number of issues you have encountered during your playthrough. Take a look at what's no longer a problem:

CHANGELOG 

- collecting items through walls - we've made sure that you no longer can pick up an object through walls in the two new DLC locations
- improved framerate in Dead Mines - a significant improvement in overall FPS throughout the level resulting in a much smoother experience
- fixed the text displaying wrong information (pickaxe) while playing on the Atlantis level
- fixed floating bubbles which now should display properly
- fixed a couple of floating objects
- fixed the item that is blocking the mine cart, should function properly upon destruction
- fixed a couple of items clipping into each other in Dead Mines
- fixed a couple of colliders not working properly in Dead Mines
- a potential fix to the crash when saving your options - thank you Zargothrax for reporting this one!
- fixed fulton interaction range - now you shouldn't be able to use the interaction from afar

The patch for GOG users is also live.


We are still running tests, but if you happen to see a bug or you have unfortunately experienced an issue please let us know by either:
- creating a thread in the Steam discussions with a description of your issue
- sending an e-mail to support@jujubee.pl, a description would be immensely helpful as well

We also respond to private messages if need be.

Please, let us know if the new patch has enhanced your gaming experience and thank you for reporting these issues! You guys are the best!

Until next time everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.05 (+New Content!)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34100478/749da45755ea40c1c14487a4b8c2d040f8bfec9c.png

HELLO EVERYONE!

Welcome to this Tuesday's update which is indeed a big one! 

We would like to begin to thank you all for your tremendous feedback, now our game is that much better! Your contribution is amazing! :)

Before we dive in, we would like to inform you guys that we have added 2 free DLCs - the entire soundtrack composed by Adam Skorupa and a set of breathtaking wallpapers featuring the game’s diving locations. Neato!

Alright, update 1.05 brings a lot to the table, so let's begin:

Added:
- a new hidden area on Dragon's Den = we won't spoil anything, you have to find it for yourself!
- the option to disable predators (and other hazards) = we hear you! No more pesky predators on your exploration voyage! When you start a location, simply press ESC and the options will be there.
- a brand new Spectator Mode = simply put, no more worries about the oxygen level, flashlight running out, or taking any kinds of damage. You cannot pick up items in this mode though!
- ROV new screen information = speed meter, water temperature meter, an indicator of how many items are in the area to collect, also, ROV will now highlight items that you can pick up.
- Scanner = now it has the ability to maintain its highlighted creatures even through walls, wrecks, plants, and other things.

Fixes:
- Dragon's Den's = the gong will now sound properly.
- Misty Lagoon = sea urchins will now remain on the ground and we've fixed a fishing net not working properly.
- Pirate's Nest = some rock issues.
- Steam Cloud = the community informed us that there were some problems, should be good now.
- first video skip = you should be able to skip the video now.
- minor optimization = the game should run a bit smoother now on some PCs.
- GUI = we've fixed some major and minor things in these languages: Chinese, Korean, Japanese.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34100478/a810c46e9b46d9b51e507ffdc6925ca0c529852b.png

Whew! That's what we've got for you this Tuesday. Let us know if you like this update, especially since now you can disable those over-aggressive predators. 

Oh! And don't forget to let us know about any bugs or issues you have encountered during your playthroughs. Please report them in the Steam discussions or send us an e-mail to: support@jujubee.pl

Thank you for your support! Let's keep an eye out for our environment!

Until next time!

PS. Yes! We are working on the VR support ;)

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34100478/749da45755ea40c1c14487a4b8c2d040f8bfec9c.png

HELLO EVERYONE!

Hello and welcome to the very first patch notes of our underwater game where we post things fixed, things added, things removed (hopefully not a lot) & things changed. We've got some interesting adjustments, but without further ado, here's what we have got for you:

Fixes:
- Frightful predators = the biggest change of the update! We've noticed and you have mentioned that predators (sharks, orcas) tend to be a little too aggressive which made them not challenging, but rather annoying. Now, shooting a predator with your Eco-Gun's single-charge mode (red light) will scare it off with just ONE shot. Oh, and the predator doesn't feel pain when hit by the blast... just wanted to be clear about this :) 
- "flying" urchins = during your playthrough you may have encountered these sea creatures that decided to float around instead of being connected to the ground. They should be where they belong now.
- AlienFX = a couple of small light adjustments.
- soft shadows = also a couple of small adjustments, though you could expect a visual difference now.
- Deep Forest = we've made some optimization work in Deep Forest, so expect a much higher framerate in that location.
- improved optimization = pretty self-explanatory here, expect a higher framerate overall.
- New Game Plus = we've removed the Eco-Gun and Scanner from the tutorial.

Added:
- ROV - a small line has been added in its interface showing the tilt angle.


This is the 1.04 update, but we have been patching the game ever since the release. Why didn't we put the patch notes from the previous versions? Professor Adams said it was top secret information.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34100478/1c8a1d193abfbbea24762daec708b35c31def942.png

Can't argue with the guy ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Alrighty, expect more updates coming in, we listen to each and every comment, message, tweet and other forms of communication, so definitely let us know if there's something in the game that bothers you. If you happen to notice a bug or glitch, please create a thread in the Steam discussions or send an e-mail to support@jujubee.pl and we will take a closer look at it.

Let us know what do you think of the game by leaving a comment below! We would love to know your opinion and in the meantime, we will see you very, very soon!

Until next time!
